messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: CI blocked on release/0.6.x because regen diffs popped after the typegen 2.1.0 bump. Some SDKs show pointer vs value flips and examples now include explicit nulls.

rohit: can you paste a minimal diff? curious if it's surface-breaking or just examples.

nina: short snippet from node example: ```json
- {\"filters\": [] }
+ {\"filters\": null }
```
That broke a few snapshot tests in sample-apps and the publish check.

sam: pointer/value flips for go and nullable changes for ruby are also present. This feels like a typegen policy violation: language-shape semantics changed without a major bump or migration notes.

devex-bot: regen-check workflow failed on branch release/0.6.x (job: regen-compare). 15 files mismatch. CI: https://ci.internal/1794200000/regen

rohit: short-term we should avoid reverting the spec. Proposal: add a small post-process step in codegen that normalizes examples & SDK shapes for patch releases so published sdks keep previous behavior. We'll file an RFC for semver policy and tooling.

nina: agree. I'll open a tiny PR to canonicalize example output when RELEASE_CHANNEL=patch and run `make regen` for node/go/ruby locally. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/codegen/pull/2425

sam: also add a preflight action `regen-precheck` that runs on PRs touching typegen/openapi/codegen and fails if examples or public-shape diffs are present. That should catch these earlier.

devex-bot: noted actions: add-regenerate-postprocess, add-regen-precheck-ci. Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/1402

ci-bot: retriggered pipeline for release/0.6.x (build #1794200058)

rohit: once the patch PR lands and CI is green we should publish the patch, then schedule an RFC review for semver rules (typegen -> language shape = major). Also add a short devex doc: "how to run regen locally" for new contributors.

nina: PR merged, ran `make regen LANGS=node,go,ruby` and committed normalized fixtures. Branch CI passing on my fork.

ci-bot: build #1794200109 succeeded, regen-compare clean. publish queued.

sam: published the patch. Created RFC draft and a short onboarding doc. Will present in next devex sync. Closing thread. :tada:
